breakdowns.sentence: 길동의 아버지는 높은 벼슬을 한 사람이었습니다.
breakdowns.translation_en: Gildong’s father was a man who held a high government post.

parts.explanation_en: This introduces Gildong’s father as the person being described.
This describes the father by the high official post he held.
The main statement says he was such a person.

breakdowns.sentence: 하지만 길동은 아버지를 “아버지”라고 부를 수 없었습니다.
breakdowns.translation_en: But Gildong could not call his father ‘Father.’

parts.explanation_en: But signals a contrast with his father’s high status.
Gildong is the topic; his father is the person he wanted to address.
This marks the exact title Gildong could not use.
This says that calling him by that title was not possible.
